# overlock

> Deterministic gate on test integrity in a git patch. Reads the diff and reports
> the edits that make a test suite ask less than it did — skipped tests, removed
> or weakened assertions, lowered coverage thresholds, narrowed test data. It
> answers one question about a change: did this make the tests pass by weakening
> the tests? No LLM calls, no network calls, no telemetry, and zero runtime
> dependencies. Node >= 20.11. MIT. Ships ESM.

This file is the map, not the manual. It exists because an agent that reaches
this project through the repository tree — rather than through an install or the
README — lands on `AGENTS.md`, which is written for someone editing overlock and
answers almost nothing about using it.

Deliberately pointer-only. Every fact about a rule, a flag or a config key
belongs to exactly one of the files below; restating any of it here would create
a copy that nothing checks and that drifts on the first rename.

## Packages

- [overlock](packages/overlock/llms.txt): the CLI, the library, the agent
  integrations and the MCP server — the whole tool is one package. It ships that
  `llms.txt` inside its npm tarball, so after an install it is readable straight
  out of `node_modules` with no network. That is the file to read when you are
  deciding how to run overlock, or what a finding is asking you to do.

## Also published

- [action.yml](action.yml): the GitHub Action, used as `rxova/overlock@v0`. The
  same analysis run on a pull request, posting the findings as one comment it
  edits in place. Its inputs and outputs are documented in the file itself.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): the manual — install, agent integration, every rule and
  how it is graded, renames, suppression, the CLI reference, the config file, the
  JSON contract, the MCP server, the Action, and the ledger.
- [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md): where to file what, and what a report needs to carry.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): the threat model, and how to report privately.

## Contributing

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the repository's invariants, and what an agent editing
  it gets wrong.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): architecture, setup, quality gates,
  releases.
